segments.t: In the courtyard, Mikhail Jekovich discovers that his three-hundred-thousand-ruble racehorse is actually a miniature pony. Meanwhile, Katya asks Denis not to pressure her while her father is in a coma, and Nikita leaves for Saint Petersburg.
Я просто хотел спросить про отца.
Денис, пожалуйста, не дави на меня.
Но мы так и не поговорили.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Wait, this is not a horse.' Even though this is not a horse, Mikhail keeps a steady face in front of Denis.

'On the other hand, he is a very thoroughbred pony.' Admitting that on the other hand he is a very thoroughbred pony shows Mikhail being honest for a change. That little word "zato" means "on the bright side", flipping a complaint into an advantage.
'Take the horse, we are even.' Once Denis should take the horse they are even, Mikhail can finally tell Denis what he means.
'They must not see us together.' Once they must not see them together, Katya can finally tell Denis what she means.
Я просто хотел спросить про отца.
'I just wanted to ask about your father.' Claiming that he just wanted to ask about Katya's father sounds confident, even if Katya has doubts.
'Dad needs an operation in Germany.' Katya tells Denis that dad needs an operation in Germany without dressing it up.
'We are looking for money everywhere right now.' Since they are looking for money everywhere right now, Katya does not waste words on excuses.
Денис, пожалуйста, не дави на меня.
'Denis, please do not pressure me.' Mentioning that do not pressure moves the talk in a new direction.
'It is truly very hard for me right now.' Saying that it is truly very hard for her right now is how Katya sets the tone with Denis.
'I am flying to Saint Petersburg right now.' Admitting that he is flying to Saint Petersburg right now shows Denis being honest for a change.
Но мы так и не поговорили.
'But we never actually talked.' Explaining that they never actually talked lays the cards on the table for Denis.

'Stand here and guard the horse.' Since Denis should stand here and guard the horse, Mikhail does not waste words on excuses. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я просто хотел спросить про отца.
Денис, пожалуйста, не дави на меня.
Но мы так и не поговорили.
While Mikhail tries to sell the pony online to recover his cash, Senya uses his turn as kitchen boss to strike a shady deal on fish. See you next time!

А ты стой здесь и сторожи
